# Downloads

> [!TIP]
> **To play with the mod, download `MWPerfFix-<version>-win32.zip` from Assets below.**
>
> Extract the ZIP and follow the included README to install it.

Other files are for troubleshooting or development:

- `MWPerfFix-<version>-win32-diagnostic.zip`: Use when asked to record performance data to help investigate a problem. Capture instructions are in the README.
- `MWPerfFix-<version>-symbols.zip`: Extra files used to investigate crashes. Not needed to install or play.
- **Source code** (ZIP or tar.gz): The code for building the mod yourself. Does not include a ready-to-install mod.
